The Life of Chuck (2025)

As 2025 comes to an end, this stands as my favorite film of the year, no hesitation.

The Life of Chuck is special for its deeply emotional, reverse-chronological story about life, death, and human connection, using an apocalyptic backdrop as a metaphor for a man's brain tumor, with standout elements being Tom Hiddleston's performance, beautiful dance scenes, and Sir Mike Flanagan's sensitive direction, all stemming from a Stephen King story. Mike turns story into something quietly profound, intimate, and deeply human. It's not about fear, or spectacle, or twists., it's about memory, time, and the meaning hidden inside an ordinary life. If this is what a Stephen King adaptation can feel like, then this might just be the finest one ever made.
